title: Derived state has no auto-supersede: two concurrent fresh summaries of one shared subject both stay current
observation: With subjects keyed by CRM site (Sofia PR #2, fc79aaf), two Sofias serving the same clinic supersede each other's summaries (a handoff, not a contradiction). But the contract does not auto-supersede `derived` records: two CONCURRENT fresh summaries of one subject each name the same incumbent in `supersedes`, so after both land the subject has two current derived records. The emulation conductor hides this by serializing writes per subject; real Sofias do not coordinate. Candidate fix in the binding: when a derived write names a record that is already superseded, either refuse with `conflict` (teach the writer to re-read) or auto-supersede the newer current one — the first keeps the contract dull and matches expected_version semantics.
evidence: Sofia emulation conductor (emulation/replay.mjs) added per-subject serialization (onSubject) so the replay stays deterministic; without it two fresh summaries of customer:Site:502 would both be current
